packages.title: Privacy §7: when a meeting is deleted or made into a note, as the app does it
brief: A correction to the unpublished legal version 2026-11-05, inside the owner's sign-off for it (see the decisions convention): the version stays 2026-11-05. Privacy §7's ‘Meeting recordings’ bullet states four retention rules; one names a case the app doesn't have, two are incomplete. Replace the whole bullet in each language with the text below, and correct the release notes that repeat the same rules. Nothing else changes.

WEB-1901 (S3), the 7-day sentence. Today: ‘A recording you stop but don’t finish becomes a note on your phone after 7 days.’ (ES «Una grabación que paras pero no terminas…», CA «Una gravació que atures però no acabes…»). In the app, pressing Stop always makes the notes (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/models/meeting.dart:14-16`, phase `finishing`), and there is no ‘finish’ control (its buttons are Keep recording, Make the notes and Discard). The 7-day rule is for a recording that stopped without Stop, because the app closed or the phone switched off (phase `interrupted`, `meeting.dart:10-12`), and the 7 days count from when the app first asks about it (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/services/meeting_store.dart:37-38`, `unanswered`, from `askedAt`; MN-26). The app's own words for that case are ‘It stopped before you pressed Stop.’ / «Se cortó antes de que pulsaras Parar.» / «S’ha tallat abans que premessis Atura.» (`meetingStoppedCut`, `app_es.arb:1447`, `app_ca.arb:1151`).

WEB-1902 (S2), the 30-day sentence. Today: ‘A meeting that is never finished is deleted 30 days after its last piece arrived.’ It leaves out a meeting that was finished but whose notes the app never saved (phone lost, uninstalled, never reopened). The server's sweep deletes every meeting whose last piece arrived over 30 days ago, finished or not, and final notes the app never acknowledged after 30 days (`../TaskFlow/Backend/core/meetings.py:642-647`, `sweep()`; MN-27). One rule replaces the special case.

WEB-1903 (S2), the Discard sentence. Today: ‘Discarding a meeting deletes it on the phone and on our server at once.’ Offline, the phone deletes the audio straight away but the server hears about it only when the phone reaches it (phase `discarding`, ‘local audio is gone, the server still has to hear it’, `meeting.dart`; `meeting_store.dart:713-740`; retried by `meeting_uploader.dart:164`). Meetings are designed for long stretches without signal (MN-11).

Replace the whole bullet, exactly. EN `Meeting recordings: our server deletes each piece’s audio once it has been turned into text, and the meeting’s text once the app has saved its notes. Whatever is left of a meeting on our server, finished or not, is deleted 30 days after its last piece arrived. A recording that stopped before you pressed Stop, and that you leave unanswered, becomes a note 7 days after the app asks you about it. Discarding a meeting deletes it from your phone at once, and from our server as soon as your phone is online. Deleting your account deletes its meetings.` / ES `Reuniones grabadas: nuestro servidor borra el audio de cada parte cuando ya es texto, y el texto de la reunión cuando la app ha guardado sus notas. Lo que quede de una reunión en nuestro servidor, terminada o no, se borra 30 días después de recibir su última parte. Una grabación que se cortó antes de que pulsaras Parar, y que dejas sin responder, se convierte en una nota 7 días después de que la app te pregunte por ella. Descartar una reunión la borra del teléfono al momento, y de nuestro servidor en cuanto el teléfono tiene conexión. Eliminar tu cuenta borra sus reuniones.` / CA `Reunions enregistrades: el nostre servidor esborra l’àudio de cada part quan ja és text, i el text de la reunió quan l’app n’ha desat les notes. El que quedi d’una reunió al nostre servidor, acabada o no, s’esborra 30 dies després de rebre’n l’última part. Un enregistrament que s’ha tallat abans que premessis Atura, i que deixes sense resposta, es converteix en una nota 7 dies després que l’app te’n pregunti. Descartar una reunió l’esborra del telèfon a l’instant, i del nostre servidor tan bon punt el telèfon té connexió. Suprimir el compte n’esborra les reunions.` The Catalan also carries WEB-1904's naming for this bullet («Reunions enregistrades», «Un enregistrament»); WP271 handles WEB-1904 everywhere else and doesn't touch this line.

Release notes, `docs/LEGAL_RELEASE.md` (English only; it is the evidence file, not a page). In line 37, replace ‘Discard deletes it at once (MN-25).’ with ‘Discard deletes the pieces on the phone at once, and the meeting on the server as soon as the phone reaches it (MN-25; phase `discarding` in `App/lib/models/meeting.dart`).’ Replace the first two sentences of line 38 (‘A meeting is deleted 30 days after its last piece arrived (MN-27, `maintain_staging`). A stopped recording left unanswered is finished into a note on the phone after 7 days (MN-26).’) with ‘Whatever is left of a meeting on the server, finished or not, is deleted 30 days after its last piece arrived, and so are final notes the app never acknowledged (MN-27, `sweep()` in `Backend/core/meetings.py`, run by `maintain_staging`). A recording that stopped before Stop was pressed (the app closed or the phone switched off) and is left unanswered is finished into a note on the phone 7 days after the app first asks about it (MN-26, `unanswered` in `App/lib/services/meeting_store.dart`).’ Keep ‘Account deletion deletes meetings, because the rows cascade from the user.’ Leave line 3's date alone.

Not to touch: every other line of the legal files (WP271 changes several in parallel), `company.json`, the site content in `src/content/site/`, and `.claude/ux-web/DECISIONS.md` (its 2026-11-05 entry summarises the rules loosely; it's the owner's record, and the main session decides whether to annotate it).
Existing tests: none asserts the old bullet (`grep -rn "Meeting recordings" tests/` is empty), so none should break. If one does, update its expected text to the brief's copy.
acceptance: On /privacy/, /es/privacy/ and /ca/privacy/ (desktop 1440 × 1000 and mobile 390 × 664, light), §7's list item that starts ‘Meeting recordings:’ / «Reuniones grabadas:» / «Reunions enregistrades:» has exactly the brief's text in that language.

No `src/content/legal/` file contains ‘you stop but don’t finish’, «paras pero no terminas», «atures però no acabes», ‘A meeting that is never finished’, «Una reunión que nunca se termina», «Una reunió que no s’acaba mai», ‘on our server at once’, «a la vez del teléfono y de nuestro servidor» or «alhora del telèfon i del nostre servidor».
The 7-day sentence names the app's stop button in each language: ‘pressed Stop’ / «pulsaras Parar» / «premessis Atura».

`docs/LEGAL_RELEASE.md` has no ‘Discard deletes it at once’ and no ‘A stopped recording left unanswered is finished into a note on the phone after 7 days’, and does contain ‘finished or not’ and ‘7 days after the app first asks about it’.

On /es/privacy/ and /ca/privacy/ at 390 × 664, §7's meeting bullet stays inside the content column (no horizontal overflow) and axe reports no violations, in light and dark; at 320 px it reflows with no horizontal scroll.
`npm run legal:check` passes, and the version on all legal pages is still 5 November 2026 / «5 de noviembre de 2026» / «5 de novembre del 2026».
